title: Sentry
summary: What is breaking in your apps, from Sentry every hour: open issues, new ones, error events and people hit, on each project's page and on Today. An issue that is new and serious, comes back or spikes rings the bell. Reads only; nothing is sent to Sentry.
changes: A Sentry project is linked by its words, so marlow-site goes to Marlow & Co as crumb-bot goes to Crumb.gg, and one that only looks alike is suggested on the Errors page for you to pick, never linked for you. A link you changed is left alone. A project that is not linked is named as it is on Sentry, after a middle dot like the rest (Open errors · billing-worker), and its older numbers follow it. The Errors page's three figures sit in one even row.
author: BrainDog

token.label: Key holding your Sentry token
token.note: In Sentry: Settings, Developer Settings, Custom Integrations, Create New Integration, Internal Integration. Give it Read on Project, Issue & Event and Organization, save, and copy the token it shows. Put it in your keys under this name.

org.label: Organization
org.note: The part of your Sentry address before .sentry.io, such as quartzapps for quartzapps.sentry.io.

region.label: Region
region.note: Where Sentry keeps your organization: us.sentry.io for most, de.sentry.io for one kept in the EU. Put your token in your keys as opening the same host.

many_users.label: Ask me when an issue hits this many people
many_users.note: An issue worth a look that has hit at least this many people also waits for you in Needs you, with a link to it on Sentry.

blocks.heading: No Sentry projects yet
blocks.body: Nothing has come from Sentry yet. If it is not connected, make a token in Sentry (Settings, Developer Settings, Custom Integrations, Create New Integration, Internal Integration, with Read on Project, Issue & Event and Organization), put it in your keys as Sentry token, and set your organization. Your projects arrive within the hour. [Set it up](/addons/sentry?set=org)
Sentry projects not linked to a project of yours: {{sentry-unlinked}}. Their numbers sit on their own until you pick one under Your project in Sentry projects below.
